finalText:
Every real call site is switched over. I moved 12 files in accounts, analytics, billing, catalog, orders, and support to `db.execute({ sql, params })`, matching the pattern already used elsewhere in the codebase.

One file still calls the old `db.query`: `vendor\legacy-orm\adapter.js`. I left it alone on purpose. Its own comment says it's a vendored copy that gets replaced wholesale on every upgrade, so any edit there would be silently lost. You'll want to fix that one upstream, not in this repo.
